content.value: Primary reading: Rozanski and Woods, Chapters 3, 13, and 15. Supplemental: ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010 and SEI Views and Beyond. This unit focuses on architecture description package.

A complete architecture description package usually combines views with context, principles, decisions, scenarios, glossary, assumptions, risks, and cross-view relationships. The package should tell a coherent architectural story.
Templates such as arc42 and Views and Beyond can help structure the package, but the architect still decides what content is necessary and how much detail is useful.
Studio: outline an architecture description table of contents for a product your team might build. Mark which sections are essential, optional, or intentionally deferred.

concepts.name: Architecture description package
concepts.description: The combined set of views, decisions, context, principles, risks, and supporting material used to describe an architecture.

concepts.name: Cross-view relationship
concepts.description: A connection or dependency between elements represented in different architecture views.

concepts.name: Architecture glossary
concepts.description: A shared vocabulary for system concepts, domain terms, architectural elements, and abbreviations.

concepts.name: Architecture template
concepts.description: A reusable structure for organizing architecture documentation and decisions.
